title: The Hilbert series of the invariants of ternary septics, octics and nonics
description: Unrefereed candidate. Determines the Hilbert series of the rings of SL3(C)-invariants of ternary forms of degrees 7, 8 and 9 (plane septics, octics and nonics); within the literature found, the largest degree previously completed was 6 (Bedratyuk-Xin 2011). The septic series equals the candidate of version 0.1.0 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.22974308), where it was proved only through degree 760; the octic and nonic series have least denominators of degrees 2331 and 1393. The method is known: Derksen's universal denominators (J. Algebra 2005) bound the poles by torus data, the functional equation (Knop; Stanley) fixes the numerator degree, and finitely many exact coefficients determine the series, as in Makam (J. Algebra 2016). Contributions: exhaustive torus-bound computations reproduced by a separately written program; correctness statements for two coefficient engines; exact coefficients with archived per-prime residues; certificates validated by re-deriving the known d = 5, 6 series; structural consequences (minimal generator counts in low degree; constraints on every system of parameters). Also records two attribution corrections to version 0.1.0. Provenance: AI-produced (Claude, Anthropic) under the direction of the publisher, Evidence Press; no human mathematical contribution is claimed and no human specialist has checked the work. Internal replay and model-based reviews only; no formal verification or specialist review; novelty within a bounded literature search.
